description: Rotary Club of Mumbai Sher-E-Punjab, in association with the Interact Club of Maruti Veers, organised an interactive two-hour workshop on “Memory Techniques, Goal Setting & Study Skills” for 94 Std. X students of R.C. Maruti High School on 30th September 2026. The session was conducted by Rtn. Avinash Mishra and focused on practical techniques to help students improve learning, memory, concentration and examination preparation. Students explored goal setting, study planning, Brain Gym, keywords, graphical methods and shape charts through engaging activities. The workshop aimed not only to keep children away from harmful content but also to empower them with positive alternatives, conscious choices and effective learning tools. President Rtn. Sunita Bedi and Rtn. Dr. Sunita Sharma steered the project, supporting the students in building confidence and developing stronger study habits.
